newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-DA SILVA DEFIES TESTING WIND TO LEAD MASTERS.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-DA SILVA DEFIES TESTING WIND TO LEAD MASTERS.

text.p: Brazilian Adilson da Silva defied strong, gusting winds to take a four-shot first round lead with a five-under-par 67 in the South African Masters at San Lameer Country Club on Thursday.
Da Silva collected six birdies during a round which featured a deft touch with the putter.
Zimbabwe's Mark McNulty was among a group of five players on 71, while defending champion Wayne Westner of South Africa, playing in less testing winds than da Silva, carded 72.
Da Silva began superbly with three successive birdies to turn in only 32.
"I holed a 20-footer at the first and knocked a 10-foot putt in on the third and those opening three holes gave me a lot of confidence for the rest of my round," da Silva said.
